question: With what mantra and substances is the goddess Kālikā satisfied?
premises: Kālikā is the object of satisfaction.
Her own seed and kula nectars are employed.
inference: The practitioner satisfies Kālikā using her own seed and the nectars of the kula.
plain_english: I satisfy Kālikā with her own seed and with the nectars of the kula.
